request: These specs have typed CSI numbers (PART 1 - GENERAL, 1.01, A., 1., a.); give them Canadian PageFormat automatic numbering
summary: Every unnumbered paragraph that starts with a typed CSI number gets the matching level style of the bundled CSC PageFormat scheme (imported with its list) and loses the typed number and the space after it; the list then shows the same counters in PageFormat ('A.' as '.1', '1.01' as '1.1'). A typo, a skipped letter or a duplicate sets the document aside.
assumptions: the scheme is the bundled CSC PageFormat scheme the user picked, attached as the template
a typed number is read in CSI's shapes (typed_as csi) and converts only where its values are the list's counters at that place
typed numbers in table cells stay as typed; paragraphs already numbered are never touched
the typed numbers are removed outright (untracked, clean copies); nothing is written
